We are pleased to announce that an initiative with NTT docomo has been featured.

docomo is working on a regional co-creation project that uses 'Nishikawa lumber' and 'd payment' — local resources of Hanno City, Saitama Prefecture — to promote effective use of forest resources and sustainable development of the regional economy. We introduce efforts to achieve both environmental conservation and social value creation through wooden QR code stands made from thinned timber.

■docomo EVERYDAY: 'From the local forest to your everyday shop. Sustainable regional co-creation expanding through Nishikawa lumber × d payment'

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2566/
